未收录 —— 本机不在 Sherwood 实测表内: Not recorded — this rig is not in Sherwood's test table
107 dB 的窄间隔动态范围在中端价位里是第一梯队：竞赛环境里邻频大台不易压住: Its 107 dB narrow-spaced dynamic range is first-class at this price: in a contest, a strong station next door struggles to bury a weak one.
菜单层级较深，社区普遍反映上手需要一段时间。: Deep menus; the community widely agrees it takes a while to learn.
噪声底 −133 dBm 比同价位更好，弱信号收听有底子。: A −133 dBm noise floor beats its price class and gives weak-signal work a solid base.
实时频谱与瀑布图对追 DX 帮助明显。: The live spectrum and waterfall clearly help chasing DX.
94 dB 的窄间隔动态范围够日常用，但大台密集时不如 FT-710。: Its 94 dB narrow-spaced dynamic range is fine day-to-day but trails the FT-710 when big stations pack the band.
76 dB 的窄间隔动态范围意味着强信号环境下更容易互调，这是价格与体积换来的。: A 76 dB narrow-spaced dynamic range means intermodulation arrives sooner in strong-signal environments — the trade-off for the price and size.
内置天调对野外架台省一套设备。: The built-in tuner saves a whole extra box when operating portable.
86 dB（3 kHz 间隔）的窄间隔动态范围在 QRP 便携机里靠前。: At 86 dB (3 kHz spacing), its narrow-spaced dynamic range ranks high among QRP portables.
体积能装进口袋，但 10W 级功率决定它更适合 CW 与轻量 SSB。: It fits in a pocket, but 10-watt-class power suits CW and light SSB best.
价格极低、配件生态庞大，是很多人第一台对讲机。: Extremely cheap with a huge accessory ecosystem — many people's first handheld.
接收性能没有公开的第三方实测数据，本文不给它打分或排名。: No published third-party receiver measurements exist, so this review gives it neither a score nor a ranking.
预算有限、想打比赛或追弱信号的短波爱好者。: HF operators on a budget who want to contest or chase weak signals.
第一台短波电台、喜欢频谱显示的用户。: Anyone buying a first HF rig who loves a spectrum display.
预算极低、以 QRP / 野外玩法为主的爱好者。: Operators on a very tight budget whose main game is QRP and portable work.
入门练手、对参数没有要求的用户。: Beginners practising the hobby who do not care about specs.
动态范围的性价比标杆；操作学习成本稍高。: The dynamic-range benchmark for the money; a slightly steeper learning curve.
均衡全面的入门经典，胜在好用而不是参数顶尖。: A balanced all-round entry classic that wins on usability, not peak specs.
低价的代价在接收动态范围；野外轻量玩法够用。: The low price costs receiver dynamic range; fine for lightweight portable play.
便携优先的选择，接收性能在同类里靠前。: Portability first, with receiver performance near the top of its class.
便宜易得；想比接收性能的话，先在机型库里录入自己的实测值。: Cheap and easy to get; to compare receive performance, first enter your own measurements in the rig library.
2–3 kHz 间隔下同时处理强台与弱台的能力；测量受相位噪声限制时，这一列就是: Handling a weak station next to a strong one at 2–3 kHz spacing; when the measurement is phase-noise limited, this column is the ARRL RMDR.
两台信号源（或一台双音源），间隔 2 kHz: Two signal generators (or one two-tone source), 2 kHz apart
20 kHz 间隔三阶互调动态范围: Third-order IMD dynamic range at 20 kHz spacing
较宽间隔下的互调抑制能力，反映滤波器与混频级的整体线性度。: Intermodulation rejection at wider spacing, reflecting the overall linearity of the filtering and mixing stages.
同上，间隔拉到 20 kHz: Same as above, spacing widened to 20 kHz
接收机本身的底噪电平（dBm），越接近 0 越好；主要由前级噪声系数决定。: The receiver's own noise level (dBm), better the closer to 0; set mainly by the front end's noise figure.
输入端接匹配负载，看频谱或电平表: Terminate the antenna input and read the spectrum or level meter
